scope: Read-only source review and CPU recomputation of saved evidence; no GPU executed by reviewer

stable_runtime_review.numerical_gate: All 32 steps x 151936 logits with atol=0.002, rtol=0.002 and exact 32 output tokens
stable_runtime_review.dtype_handling: Eager FP16 and upstream Graph FP32 buffer snapshots are converted only on CPU to a common FP32 representation; FP16 values are exactly representable. GPU model arithmetic is unchanged.
stable_runtime_review.correctness: 105 frozen/source files and 64 arrays checked; 4861952 compared values all have equal FP32 bit patterns; maximum absolute difference 0; actual Graph replay count 31
stable_runtime_review.timing: 106 frozen/source files, 6 fresh processes and all 30 samples checked; two warmups and five samples per worker; perf_counter interval includes actual GPU completion and output handling
stable_runtime_review.baseline_interpretation: Original Eager versus original whole-decode Graph through the same persistent runtime interface. This does not establish a new Triton kernel win or superiority over upstream Graph.
stable_runtime_review.lifecycle_limit: Sequential requests only. close() must not be called concurrently with generate(); README now explicitly states this limit.

graph_greedy_static_review.operation: Captures the same torch.argmax(dim=-1) and Engine int32 conversion after the existing original FP32 logits buffer assignment; no changed model/KV math or extra token/logits copy
graph_greedy_static_review.lifetime: Runner holds the captured token tensor; each actual replay rewrites that stable storage and issues one ticket; each sample attempt consumes the ticket, including mismatches
graph_greedy_static_review.guards: Pinned original graph/engine/sample source, one engine, TP1, explicit Graph[1], disabled overlap, B1 decode, greedy temperature semantics, logits shape/stride/dtype/device/pointer/storage-offset, token metadata/storage and stream checks
graph_greedy_static_review.ordering_evidence: Pinned Engine.forward_batch runs on engine stream; disabled-overlap scheduler copies next_tokens_gpu to token_pool and CPU, synchronizes completion while processing the request, then advances to the next replay. The persistent token buffer is safe under this sequential contract.
graph_greedy_static_review.fallback: Nonmatching sample calls delegate to original sampling; assert_usage must reject missing expected hits before any speed claim
graph_greedy_static_review.baseline_requirement: Uninstall restores Python methods but cannot remove nodes from existing captured graphs. Original and candidate comparisons require fresh Engine/process construction.
graph_greedy_static_review.unverified: No Graph capture, token equivalence, novel-candidate timing or promotion is claimed by this static review.
